scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,app,api -c cyan,magenta,green "npm run dev:safe -w @virlux/web" "npm run dev -w @virlux/app" "npm run dev -w @virlux/api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @virlux/shared && npm run build -w @virlux/api && npm run build -w @virlux/web && npm run build -w @virlux/app
